Isabella Rodriguez.description: working at the counter serving customers and ensuring a welcoming atmosphere (taking customer orders) @ the Ville:Hobbs Cafe:cafe:behind the cafe counter

Maria Lopez.description: conversing about Maria Lopez and Klaus Mueller discussing plans to organize interviews at Hobbs Cafe for Klaus's gentrification study research. @ <persona> Klaus Mueller
chat: Maria Lopez
Hey Klaus, I saw you were in the middle of working on your research paper. How’s it going?
Klaus Mueller
Hi Maria, I'm making good progress. Actually, your suggestions on doing interviews really helped me refine my approach to gathering qualitative data for my gentrification study.
Maria Lopez
That's great to hear! I'm excited to see how the interviews go. Have you scheduled any yet?
Klaus Mueller
Yes, I have a few scheduled for tomorrow. Isabella actually suggested we could use Hobbs Cafe as a location to conduct some interviews too.
Maria Lopez
That sounds like a great idea! Hobbs Cafe is such a lively place and people might feel more comfortable sharing their stories here. I can help organize it if you want.
Klaus Mueller
That would be fantastic, Maria. Your help organizing it will definitely make a big difference. Thanks so much!
Maria Lopez
Awesome! Let’s set up a day and time that works best for both of us to start planning. I can also reach out to some people who might be interested in participating.
Klaus Mueller
That sounds great. How about we plan to meet at Hobbs Cafe tomorrow afternoon to discuss details and perhaps start reaching out to potential interviewees?
Maria Lopez
Sounds perfect! Let’s meet around 2 pm then. I’ll start reaching out to some folks and see who’s available. Can’t wait for our meeting!
Klaus Mueller
Sounds good, Maria. I'll bring some ideas for interview questions and we can discuss how to make this a smooth process.
Maria Lopez
Great, looking forward to our meeting! See you tomorrow at 2 pm. Have a great rest of your day!
Klaus Mueller
Thanks, Maria. I'll be there at 2 pm sharp. See you tomorrow!
